A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Jenet''' served as a member of the [[Peace Brigade]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. When the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Lowbacca]] were attacked by the brigade, the [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] participated. He was knocked out of the fight by a kick to the face by Solo.
